About me

The story
behind the studio

"Every brand deserves a story worth remembering."

I'm a young graphic designer who believes that every color holds emotion and every line tells a story. I love creating designs that feel alive — blending imagination, warmth, and purpose through each detail. Since 2019, I've worked across logo design, advertising, and video editing to help brands say something true.

How a
project unfolds

Six steps, one collaboration — from first conversation to final files.

01

Discovery

Understanding the client's brand, goals, target audience, and project requirements.

02

Research & Explore

Gathering inspiration, analyzing references, and exploring creative directions.

03

Concept Development

Brainstorming layouts, color palettes, typography, and visual elements.

04

Design & Refine

Bringing the concept to life — composition, hierarchy, and aesthetics.

05

Feedback & Revisions

Collaborating with the client and refining until the design meets expectations.

06

Final Delivery

Preparing polished, high-quality files ready for digital or print use.
